interpretation: The alias fix is neutral on the independent external holdout. Retrieval context is sufficient in 17/20 cases, while the weak reader is fully correct in 12/20, partial in 1/20, and incorrect in 7/20. Five cases have sufficient visible context but a wrong/unsupported reader outcome (H01, H05, H14, H15, H16), demonstrating a reader/use-of-context bottleneck distinct from the fixed retrieval bug.

notable_context_gaps.H08: StrictInt or another requested strict alias is not visible
